title: BISStandardSchema
description: Standardized JSON Schema for BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) documents used in the BIS RAG Assistant and Compliance Checker.

standard_id.description: Unique identifier formatted as IS_NUMBER_YEAR, e.g. IS_10500_2012

title.description: Full official title of the Indian Standard

short_title.description: Short or colloquial title for UI display and compact summaries

edition.description: Revision or edition status, e.g. Second Revision

reaffirmation_year.description: Most recent reaffirmation year by BIS sectional committee, if applicable

domain.description: Primary industry or technical domain (e.g. Food Safety & Water, Mechanical Engineering, Civil & Construction)

category.description: Specific sub-category (e.g. Water Quality, Material Testing, Structural Steel)

department.description: BIS Technical Division, e.g. Food and Agriculture Division (FAD), Mechanical Engineering Division (MED)

technical_committee.description: BIS Sectional Committee ID and name, e.g. FAD 25 (Drinking Water)

ics_code.description: International Classification for Standards (ICS) code, e.g. 13.060.20

scope.description: Full verbatim or comprehensive scope defining what is covered and excluded

description.description: Executive summary and technical purpose of the standard for RAG retrieval context

key_requirements.description: Structured parameters and thresholds for automated compliance evaluation and table lookups

parameter.description: Specific physical, chemical, mechanical, or electrical characteristic

requirement.description: Specification limit, test criteria, or descriptive rule

acceptable_limit.description: Baseline desirable or minimum acceptable value

permissible_limit.description: Maximum allowable limit under relaxation / alternative source conditions

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. mg/l, MPa, mm, %)

test_method.description: Reference standard or test method clause (e.g. IS 3025 Part 11)

clause_reference.description: Exact clause or table in the standard (e.g. Table 1, Clause 4.2)

sections.description: Ordered sections and clauses enabling precise chunking and cited section-level retrieval in RAG

content.description: Detailed text content of the section/clause

page_number.description: Document page number for citation generation

applicable_products_or_industries.description: List of industrial domains, commercial applications, or product types subject to this standard

keywords.description: Search tags, synonyms, acronyms, and keywords for BM25 and hybrid search ranking

related_standards.description: Normative references and related IS / ISO / IEC standards

source.description: Publishing authority, e.g. Bureau of Indian Standards

source_url.description: Official BIS URL or standard portal repository reference

standard.description: Standard code for citation metadata, e.g. IS 10500:2012

mandatory_certification.description: Indicates if compliance is legally mandated by a Quality Control Order (QCO)

quality_control_order.description: Name and date of applicable Government Quality Control Order

version_tag.description: Version tag for vector DB ingestion pipeline
